verdict.rationale: The pack has no documented API for retrieving transaction lists, settlement or payout reports, or daily takings for ledger reconciliation. The only reconciliation mention is a marketing line. The other items are adjacent: Customer Area UI management, webhooks that push individual payment outcomes, payout-method settings, and an MCP server whose transaction or payout tools are not described. None of these shows an agent pulling transactions and payouts via API to reconcile.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent pull transactions and payouts via API and reconcile daily takings into my ledger
